content.description: File content. Decoded size cap is 1048576 bytes. A path-like string is added literally.

filename.description: Optional name; when set the file is wrapped in a directory. It may not contain /, and it may not be . or .. alone.

pin.description: Pin the added content recursively. Required and explicit.

provide.description: Announce the CID to the routing system. Required and explicit; has no effect when the node has Provide.Enabled=false.

cid_version.description: Recipe override. Omit to keep the default recipe.

raw_leaves.description: Recipe override. Omit to keep the default recipe.

chunker.description: Recipe override. Omit to keep the default recipe.

hash.description: Recipe override. Omit to keep the default recipe.

confirm_token.description: Binding handle from a previous confirmation_required result. Accepted only after a human approved that confirmation (ADR-0003); omit on the first call.
